# Benchmarks

Kevlar vs [Polly v8](https://github.com/App-vNext/Polly) across every strategy, measured with [BenchmarkDotNet](https://benchmarkdotnet.org/) on GitHub Actions and republished automatically by the [benchmarks workflow](https://github.com/thomhurst/Kevlar/actions/workflows/benchmarks.yml).

*Last updated 2026-08-25 10:37 UTC (commit `4fa0eaa`).*

:::note
Microbenchmarks on shared CI runners are noisy. The **vs Polly** column is the median ratio over the most recent runs (up to 10); anything within ±20% is reported as *on par*. Absolute times move with runner hardware — the ratios are the signal.
:::

## Pipeline overhead floor

What an empty pipeline costs per execution — the fixed tax every strategy builds on.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Empty pipeline — async | 17.1 ns | 57.2 ns | 0 B | 0 B | **3.6× faster** |
| Empty pipeline — reference-state baseline | 13.9 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| Empty pipeline — caller-seeded context | 118 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| EmptyOutcomeState | 9.2 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| EmptyTaskOutcomeState | 11.5 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| Empty pipeline — zero-closure state overload | 16.2 ns | 60.4 ns | 0 B | 0 B | **4.0× faster** |
| Empty pipeline — sync | 8.6 ns | 29.0 ns | 0 B | 0 B | **3.3× faster** |

## Retry

Happy path (judge overhead only) and a recovery path where every call fails twice before succeeding, with backoff disabled so only strategy machinery is measured.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Retry(3) — success on first attempt | 127 ns | 266 ns | 0 B | 24 B | **2.1× faster** |
| Retry(3) — two failures then success | 4.00 μs | 4.57 μs | 192 B | 328 B | on par |

## Timeout

The timeout never fires; this is the cost of arming and disarming the cancellation plumbing on every call.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Timeout(10 s) — completes instantly | 211 ns | 208 ns | 0 B | 0 B | on par |
| SynchronousGenerator_HappyPath | 229 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| AsynchronousGenerator_HappyPath | 1.70 μs | — | 712 B | — | — |
| AsyncHookConfigured_HappyPath | 203 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |

## Circuit breaker

Ratio/sampling bookkeeping while closed, and the fast-fail rejection cost while manually isolated (thrown exception included).

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Isolated circuit — fast-fail rejection | 5.50 μs | 5.56 μs | 1.3 KB | 1.3 KB | on par |
| Ratio breaker, closed — success | 227 ns | 288 ns | 0 B | 24 B | **1.2× faster** |
| DynamicDurationConfigured | 237 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| AsyncCallbackConfigured | 233 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |

## Fallback

Pass-through when the execution succeeds, and substitution when it throws.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NoNotification | 2.40 μs | — | 200 B | — | — |
| SyncNotification | 2.39 μs | — | 200 B | — | — |
| CompletedAsyncNotification | 2.40 μs | — | 200 B | — | — |
| YieldingAsyncNotification | 5.96 μs | — | 871 B | — | — |
| Fallback — not triggered | 135 ns | 135 ns | 0 B | 0 B | on par |
| Fallback — triggered by exception | 2.43 μs | 2.48 μs | 200 B | 256 B | on par |

## Rate limit

Uncontended token-bucket permit acquisition — every call is admitted.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Token bucket — uncontended acquire | 180 ns | 167 ns | 0 B | 0 B | on par |
| WithHooks_Uncontended | 175 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| FrameworkAdapter_Uncontended | 172 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |
| PartitionedFrameworkAdapter_Uncontended | 191 ns | — | 32 B | — | — |

## Concurrency limit

A single caller against a large permit count; acquire/release cost with no queueing.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Concurrency limit — uncontended | 156 ns | 199 ns | 0 B | 40 B | **1.3× faster** |
| WithHooks_Uncontended | 155 ns | — | 0 B | — | — |

## Typed result handling

Retry configured to treat a sentinel result as a failure; the returned value never matches, so this is the per-call cost of judging results.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Typed retry — result judged, no retry | 125 ns | 208 ns | 0 B | 0 B | **1.7× faster** |

## Composed pipelines

How per-call overhead scales with pipeline depth when nothing goes wrong.

| Scenario | Kevlar | Polly | Kevlar allocated | Polly allocated | Kevlar vs Polly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Timeout → Retry → ratio breaker | 377 ns | 704 ns | 0 B | 48 B | **1.9× faster** |
| Token bucket → Timeout → Retry → ratio breaker → Concurrency limit | 549 ns | 1.00 μs | 0 B | 88 B | **1.9× faster** |

## Environment

- AMD EPYC 7763
- .NET 10.0.11 (10.0.11, 10.0.1126.37416), BenchmarkDotNet 0.15.8
- Times are medians; allocations are per operation.

## Reproduce

```bash
dotnet run -c Release --project benchmarks/Kevlar.Benchmarks -- --filter '*'
```

As always with microbenchmarks: measure your own workload before optimizing around these numbers. Nanosecond differences matter in tight loops and high-throughput services; they don't matter around a 50 ms network call.
